set.question_en: A 20-year-old with a full G licence is stopped by police and has a small amount of alcohol in their system (below .05). Under the penalties in effect since July 1, 2026, what happens at the roadside for a first occurrence?
set.question_zh: 一名 20 岁、持正式 G 牌的司机被警察拦下，体内有少量酒精（低于 0.05）。按 2026 年 7 月 1 日起实行的处罚，第一次被查到时当场会怎样？

options.en: Nothing, because the BAC is below .05
options.zh: 没有处罚，因为血液酒精浓度低于 0.05

set.explanation_zh: 21 岁及以下的司机（以及 G1、G2、M1、M2 新手）必须零酒精、零毒品。ontario.ca 现行规定（2026-07-01 起）：第一次当场停牌 7 天，另要上 8 小时教育课程、交 $250 罚款；第二次 14 天，第三次 30 天。定罪后还要罚 $60～$1,000。注意：手册这一节（2022 年版）还写着“当场停牌 24 小时”，考试时如果选项里没有 7 天、只有 24 小时，就按手册选 24 小时。
set.explanation_en: Drivers 21 and under must have zero alcohol; since July 1, 2026 a first occurrence brings an immediate 7-day suspension (the 2022 handbook text still says 24 hours).
set.handbook_basis: Handbook (2022) says 24-hour roadside suspension; ontario.ca (2026) lists 7-day suspension, 8-hour course, $250 for a first occurrence.
